question: An emergency vehicle approaches, but you are near a sharp bend. What should you do?
question_rw: Ikinyabiziga gitabara cyihutirwa kirakwegereye, ariko uri hafi y'ikoni rikaze. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Slow down and make way at a safe place
Drive onto the opposite lane immediately
options_rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko ukagiha inzira ahantu hatekanye
Guhita winjira mu murongo w'ibinyabiziga biva imbere
answer: Slow down and make way at a safe place
answer_rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko ukagiha inzira ahantu hatekanye
explanation: Do not make a sudden or dangerous manoeuvre. Create space for the emergency vehicle when it is safe to do so.
explanation_rw: Ntugakore igikorwa gitunguranye cyangwa giteje akaga. Ha ikinyabiziga gitabara umwanya ahantu hatekanye.

question: You are entering a road from a private driveway. Who should you give way to?
question_rw: Ugiye kwinjira mu muhanda uvuye mu rugo cyangwa mu kibanza cyihariye. Ugomba guha inzira bande?
options: Road users already on the road
Only vehicles coming from the left
answer: Road users already on the road
explanation: When entering a public road from private property, give way to traffic and pedestrians already using the road.
explanation_rw: Iyo winjiye mu muhanda nyabagendwa uvuye mu kibanza cyihariye, banza uhe inzira ibinyabiziga n'abanyamaguru basanzwe bawukoresha.

question: You are reversing out of a parking space into a road. What should you do?
question_rw: Urimo gusubiza imodoka inyuma uyivana aho yari iparitse kugira ngo winjire mu muhanda. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Check carefully and give way to other road users
Use the horn instead of checking
options_rw: Kureba neza no guha inzira abandi bakoresha umuhanda
answer: Check carefully and give way to other road users
answer_rw: Kureba neza no guha inzira abandi bakoresha umuhanda
explanation: Reversing requires special care. Do not reverse until you have checked that the road is clear and safe.
explanation_rw: Gusubira inyuma bisaba ubwitonzi bwihariye. Ntugasubire inyuma utabanje kugenzura ko inzira itekanye kandi nta wundi uyikoresha.

question: You are leaving a parking area and joining a public road. Who has priority?
question_rw: Urimo kuva aho imodoka ziparika winjira mu muhanda nyabagendwa. Ni nde ufite uburenganzira bwo kubanza?
options: Traffic already on the public road
The vehicle leaving the parking area
The vehicle with the loudest horn
options_rw: Ibinyabiziga bisanzwe biri mu muhanda nyabagendwa
Ikinyabiziga gifite ihoni riranguruye kurusha ayandi
answer: Traffic already on the public road
answer_rw: Ibinyabiziga bisanzwe biri mu muhanda nyabagendwa
explanation: A driver leaving a parking area must wait and give way before joining the road.
explanation_rw: Umuyobozi uva aho imodoka ziparika agomba gutegereza no guha inzira abandi mbere yo kwinjira mu muhanda.

question: At an intersection, a vehicle is approaching from your right and another from your left. There are no signs or lights. Which one should you give way to?
question_rw: Ku isangano, ikinyabiziga kimwe kiva iburyo bwawe ikindi kiva ibumoso, kandi nta byapa cyangwa amatara bihari. Ni ikihe ugomba guha inzira?
options: The vehicle approaching from your right
The vehicle approaching from your left
Both must always stop for you
The vehicle that sounds its horn
answer: The vehicle approaching from your right
explanation: At an uncontrolled intersection, apply the general rule of giving way to traffic approaching from the right.
explanation_rw: Ku isangano ridafite ibimenyetso biyobora urujya n'uruza, kurikiza ihame rusange ryo guha inzira ibinyabiziga biva iburyo bwawe.

question: You arrive at an intersection at the same time as another vehicle, and that vehicle is on your right. What should you do?
question_rw: Uhuriye ku isangano n'ikindi kinyabiziga icyarimwe, kandi kiri iburyo bwawe. Ugomba gukora iki?
explanation: Where the general right-hand priority rule applies, give way to the vehicle approaching from your right.
explanation_rw: Iyo ihame ryo guha inzira ikinyabiziga kiva iburyo rikurikizwa, ugomba kukiha inzira.

question: You are on a road marked as a priority road. What does this mean?
question_rw: Uri mu muhanda ugaragajwe nk'umuhanda ufite uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere. Ibyo bisobanura iki?
options: Traffic from side roads must give way as indicated by the signs
You may ignore all traffic rules
You may drive at any speed
options_rw: Ibinyabiziga biva mu mihanda iyinjiramo bigomba gutanga inzira nk'uko ibyapa bibiteganya
Ushobora kugenda ku muvuduko uwo ari wo wose
answer: Traffic from side roads must give way as indicated by the signs
answer_rw: Ibinyabiziga biva mu mihanda iyinjiramo bigomba gutanga inzira nk'uko ibyapa bibiteganya
explanation: A priority-road sign indicates priority over traffic entering from side roads, but you must still obey signals and drive carefully.
explanation_rw: Icyapa cy'umuhanda ufite uburenganzira bwo kubanza kigaragaza ko ufite inzira imbere y'ibiva mu mihanda iyinjiramo, ariko ugomba gukomeza kubahiriza ibimenyetso no gutwara witonze.

question: You see an inverted triangular GIVE WAY sign before an intersection. What does it mean?
question_rw: Ubonye icyapa cya GIVE WAY gifite ishusho ya mpandeshatu ihinditse mbere y'isangano. Gisobanura iki?
options: Give way to traffic on the road ahead
options_rw: Guha inzira ibinyabiziga biri mu muhanda ugiye kwinjiramo
Ufite uburenganzira bwo kubanza imbere ya bose
answer: Give way to traffic on the road ahead
answer_rw: Guha inzira ibinyabiziga biri mu muhanda ugiye kwinjiramo
explanation: The inverted triangle is a priority sign requiring you to give way to traffic on the road you are approaching.
explanation_rw: Iyo mpandeshatu ihinditse ni icyapa kigusaba guha inzira ibinyabiziga biri mu muhanda ugiye kwinjiramo.

question: At a junction, you see a STOP sign but no other vehicles. What must you do?
question_rw: Ku isangano ubonye icyapa cya STOP ariko nta kindi kinyabiziga ubona. Ugomba gukora iki?
explanation: The STOP requirement applies even when the road appears empty.
explanation_rw: Itegeko ryo guhagarara kuri STOP rirakurikizwa nubwo umuhanda usa n'aho nta kinyabiziga kirimo.

question: You are approaching a junction and cannot see clearly because buildings block your view. What should you do?
question_rw: Ugeze ku isangano ariko inyubako zikakubuza kureba neza ibiri ku mpande. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Close your eyes briefly and continue
explanation: Limited visibility means you must reduce speed and make sure the junction is safe before entering.
explanation_rw: Iyo utabona neza, ugomba kugabanya umuvuduko no kugenzura ko isangano ritekanye mbere yo kurinjiramo.

question: A vehicle in front of you has stopped to give way at an intersection. What should you do?
question_rw: Ikinyabiziga kiri imbere yawe cyahagaze kugira ngo gitange inzira ku isangano. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Drive around it on the pavement
explanation: Do not overtake a vehicle that has stopped to give way if doing so could create danger or violate road rules.
explanation_rw: Nturenze ikinyabiziga cyahagaze gitanga inzira niba kubikora byateza akaga cyangwa bikaba binyuranyije n'amategeko y'umuhanda.

question: You are approaching a roundabout and a vehicle is already circulating near your entry. What should you do?
question_rw: Ugeze kuri roundabout, ubona ikinyabiziga kiri kuyizengurukamo hafi y'aho ushaka kwinjirira. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Wait and give way until it is safe to enter
options_rw: Gutegereza ukagiha inzira kugeza igihe kwinjira biba bitekanye
answer: Wait and give way until it is safe to enter
answer_rw: Gutegereza ukagiha inzira kugeza igihe kwinjira biba bitekanye
explanation: Give way to circulating traffic and enter only when there is enough safe space.
explanation_rw: Ha inzira ibinyabiziga biri muri roundabout, winjiremo ari uko habonetse umwanya uhagije kandi utekanye.

question: When approaching a roundabout, which direction should you check for circulating traffic?
question_rw: Iyo wegereye roundabout, ni mu cyerekezo ki ugomba kubanza kureba ibinyabiziga biyizengurukamo?
options: To the right and around the roundabout
options_rw: Iburyo no mu cyerekezo ibinyabiziga bizengurukamo
answer: To the right and around the roundabout
answer_rw: Iburyo no mu cyerekezo ibinyabiziga bizengurukamo
explanation: Check for vehicles already circulating, especially those approaching from your right, before entering.
explanation_rw: Mbere yo kwinjira, genzura ibinyabiziga biri kuyizengurukamo, cyane cyane ibikwegereye bivuye iburyo.

question: You are inside a roundabout and want to leave at the next exit. What should you do?
question_rw: Uri muri roundabout kandi ushaka gusohokera ku muhanda ukurikiyeho. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Signal your intention and leave when safe
options_rw: Kwerekana icyerekezo ushaka kujyamo ukoresheje ikinyoteri, ugasohoka igihe bitekanye
Gusubira inyuma ugasohokera aho wari wanyuze
answer: Signal your intention and leave when safe
answer_rw: Kwerekana icyerekezo ushaka kujyamo ukoresheje ikinyoteri, ugasohoka igihe bitekanye
explanation: Use the appropriate indicator to show your exit and check for pedestrians and other road users.
explanation_rw: Koresha ikinyoteri gikwiye werekane aho usohokera kandi urebe abanyamaguru n'abandi bakoresha umuhanda.

question: You miss your intended exit at a roundabout. What is the safest action?
question_rw: Warengeje aho washakaga gusohokera muri roundabout. Igikorwa cyizewe ni ikihe?
options: Continue around and take the next safe opportunity
options_rw: Gukomeza kuzenguruka ugafata andi mahirwe yo gusohoka mu mutekano
answer: Continue around and take the next safe opportunity
answer_rw: Gukomeza kuzenguruka ugafata andi mahirwe yo gusohoka mu mutekano
explanation: Never reverse or stop dangerously in a roundabout. Continue safely and use another exit.
explanation_rw: Ntugasubire inyuma cyangwa ngo uhagarare nabi muri roundabout. Komeza witonze ukoreshe ahandi hasohokera.

question: A cyclist is travelling straight ahead while you want to turn across the cyclist's path. What should you do?
question_rw: Umuntu uri ku igare arakomeza agana imbere, wowe ushaka gukata ukambuka inzira ye. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Give way and wait until the cyclist has passed safely
Turn quickly in front of the cyclist
Sound your horn and force the cyclist to stop
options_rw: Kumuha inzira ugategereza kugeza arenze neza
answer: Give way and wait until the cyclist has passed safely
answer_rw: Kumuha inzira ugategereza kugeza arenze neza
explanation: Do not cut across a cyclist's path. Wait until the cyclist has passed and the turn is safe.
explanation_rw: Ntukambuke imbere y'umuntu uri ku igare. Tegereza abanze arengere kandi ubone ko gukata bitekanye.

question: A motorcyclist is overtaking you while you are preparing to turn. What should you do?
question_rw: Umumotari arimo kukunyuraho mu gihe witegura gukata. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Check mirrors and blind spots before turning
options_rw: Kureba mu ndorerwamo no mu hantu utabonesha neza mbere yo gukata
Guhita ujya ku ruhande utabanje kureba
answer: Check mirrors and blind spots before turning
answer_rw: Kureba mu ndorerwamo no mu hantu utabonesha neza mbere yo gukata
explanation: Check carefully for motorcycles and other road users before changing direction.
explanation_rw: Mbere yo guhindura icyerekezo, genzura neza ko nta mumotari cyangwa undi ukoresha umuhanda uri hafi yawe.

question: You are driving behind a long queue of vehicles near an intersection. What should you avoid?
question_rw: Urimo gutwara inyuma y'umurongo muremure w'ibinyabiziga hafi y'isangano. Ni iki ugomba kwirinda?
options: Entering the intersection if you cannot clear it
options_rw: Kwinjira mu isangano niba udashobora kurivamo
answer: Entering the intersection if you cannot clear it
answer_rw: Kwinjira mu isangano niba udashobora kurivamo
explanation: Do not enter an intersection unless there is enough space to clear it without blocking cross traffic.
explanation_rw: Ntukinjire mu isangano niba nta mwanya uhagije uhari wo kurivamo utabujije ibinyabiziga bigenda mu kindi cyerekezo.

question: What should you do when approaching a yellow box junction?
question_rw: Iyo wegereye isangano ririmo imirongo y'umuhondo ya Yellow Box, ugomba gukora iki?
options: Enter only when your exit is clear
Enter even when traffic is blocked
Use the box as a parking space
options_rw: Kwinjiramo ari uko aho usohokera hafunguye
answer: Enter only when your exit is clear
answer_rw: Kwinjiramo ari uko aho usohokera hafunguye
explanation: A yellow box must be kept clear. Enter only if you can pass through without stopping inside it.
explanation_rw: Agace ka Yellow Box kagomba kuguma gafunguye. Kinjiramo gusa niba ushobora kukambuka utagombye guhagararamo.

question: Why should you never block an intersection?
question_rw: Kuki utagomba na rimwe gufunga isangano uhagaze mu nzira?
options: It obstructs other traffic and can delay emergency vehicles
options_rw: Bibera abandi inzitizi kandi bishobora gutinza ibinyabiziga bitabara
answer: It obstructs other traffic and can delay emergency vehicles
answer_rw: Bibera abandi inzitizi kandi bishobora gutinza ibinyabiziga bitabara
explanation: Keeping intersections clear helps traffic flow and leaves room for emergency services.
explanation_rw: Kudasiba amasangano bituma urujya n'uruza rukomeza kandi bigasigira umwanya ibinyabiziga bitabara.

question: A pedestrian is crossing the road when you are turning into that road. What should you do?
question_rw: Umugenzi arimo kwambuka umuhanda mu gihe wowe winjira muri uwo muhanda ukata. Ugomba gukora iki?
explanation: When turning, watch for pedestrians crossing the road you are entering and allow them to cross safely.
explanation_rw: Iyo ukata winjira mu wundi muhanda, genzura abanyamaguru bawambukiramo kandi ubahe umwanya wo kwambuka neza.

question: You are turning into a road where children are crossing. What is the correct action?
question_rw: Urimo gukata winjira mu muhanda urimo kwambukiramo abana. Igikorwa gikwiye ni ikihe?
options: Stop and allow them to cross safely
answer: Stop and allow them to cross safely
explanation: Children may move unpredictably. Stop when necessary and give them enough time and space to cross.
explanation_rw: Abana bashobora kugenda mu buryo butunguranye. Hagarara igihe bikenewe ubahe umwanya uhagije wo kwambuka.

question: A bus has stopped near a pedestrian crossing. What should you do?
question_rw: Bisi yahagaze hafi y'ahambukira abanyamaguru. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Slow down and watch for pedestrians
options_rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko ukareba niba nta banyamaguru bahari
Kwirengagiza ko hashobora kuba hari abanyamaguru
answer: Slow down and watch for pedestrians
answer_rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko ukareba niba nta banyamaguru bahari
explanation: Passengers may be crossing in front of or behind a stopped bus. Proceed carefully.
explanation_rw: Abagenzi bashobora kuba bambuka imbere ya bisi cyangwa inyuma yayo. Komeza witonze.

question: You are driving on a road with a traffic officer directing vehicles. Which instruction should you follow?
question_rw: Uri mu muhanda urimo umupolisi uyobora ibinyabiziga. Ni ayahe mabwiriza ugomba gukurikiza?
options: The instructions of the driver behind you
explanation: An authorised officer's instructions take priority over other traffic control signs and signals.
explanation_rw: Amabwiriza y'umukozi ubifitiye ububasha aruta ibindi byapa n'amatara ayobora urujya n'uruza.

question: A police officer raises one arm to signal traffic to stop. What should you do?
question_rw: Umupolisi azamuye ukuboko kumwe asaba ibinyabiziga guhagarara. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Stop as instructed, unless you are already in the intersection and must clear it
options_rw: Guhagarara nk'uko abitegetse, keretse niba wari wamaze kugera mu isangano ugomba kurivamo
answer: Stop as instructed, unless you are already in the intersection and must clear it
answer_rw: Guhagarara nk'uko abitegetse, keretse niba wari wamaze kugera mu isangano ugomba kurivamo
explanation: Follow the officer's signal. Vehicles already in the intersection should clear it safely.
explanation_rw: Kurikiza ikimenyetso cy'umupolisi. Ibinyabiziga byamaze kugera mu isangano bigomba kurivamo mu mutekano.

question: At a junction, a traffic officer gives you permission to proceed while the light is red. What should you do?
question_rw: Ku isangano, umupolisi akweretse ko wakomeza kandi itara ryaka umutuku. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Proceed carefully as directed by the officer
Ignore the officer and wait for green
answer: Proceed carefully as directed by the officer
explanation: The authorised officer's direction takes priority, but you must still proceed carefully and watch for other road users.
explanation_rw: Amabwiriza y'umupolisi ubifitiye ububasha ni yo akurikizwa, ariko ugomba gukomeza witonze ureba abandi bakoresha umuhanda.

question: You are approaching an intersection and the traffic lights are not working. What should you do?
question_rw: Ugeze ku isangano usanga amatara ayobora urujya n'uruza adakora. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Slow down, observe signs and give way according to the applicable rules
Follow the vehicle in front blindly
options_rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba ibyapa no gutanga inzira hakurikijwe amategeko akurikizwa
Kwibwira ko ari wowe ufite uburenganzira bwo kubanza
answer: Slow down, observe signs and give way according to the applicable rules
answer_rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko, kureba ibyapa no gutanga inzira hakurikijwe amategeko akurikizwa
explanation: Treat a signal failure cautiously. Follow any signs or officer instructions and enter only when safe.
explanation_rw: Iyo amatara adakora, witwara witonze. Kurikiza ibyapa cyangwa amabwiriza y'umupolisi kandi winjire ari uko bitekanye.

question: You are on a road with a priority sign, but a police officer directs you to stop. What should you do?
question_rw: Uri mu muhanda ufite icyapa cy'uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere, ariko umupolisi akubwiye guhagarara. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Continue because you are on a priority road
options_rw: Gukomeza kuko uri mu muhanda ufite uburenganzira bwo kubanza
explanation: The instructions of an authorised traffic officer take priority over road signs.
explanation_rw: Amabwiriza y'umupolisi ubifitiye ububasha aruta ibyapa byo mu muhanda.

question: You are approaching a narrow bridge where only one vehicle can pass at a time. What should you do?
question_rw: Ugeze ku kiraro kigufi ku buryo ikinyabiziga kimwe ari cyo gishobora kunyuraho icyarimwe. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Follow priority signs and wait if another vehicle has priority
Enter even when another vehicle is crossing
Force the other vehicle to reverse
options_rw: Gukurikiza ibyapa bigena uwubanza no gutegereza niba ikindi kinyabiziga ari cyo gifite inzira
Kwinjira nubwo hari ikindi kinyabiziga kirimo kukambuka
answer: Follow priority signs and wait if another vehicle has priority
answer_rw: Gukurikiza ibyapa bigena uwubanza no gutegereza niba ikindi kinyabiziga ari cyo gifite inzira
explanation: At narrow bridges, obey priority signs and never enter when doing so would prevent safe passage.
explanation_rw: Ku biraro bigufi, kurikiza ibyapa bigena uwubanza kandi ntukinjiremo niba byabuza ikindi kinyabiziga kunyura mu mutekano.

question: You meet another vehicle on a narrow road and there is not enough room for both to pass. What should you do?
question_rw: Uhuriye n'ikindi kinyabiziga mu muhanda ufunganye kandi nta mwanya uhagije wo kunyuranaho mwembi. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Slow down, communicate carefully and allow safe passage according to the situation
options_rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko, kwitwararika no kureka ikinyabiziga kikanyura mu mutekano hakurikijwe uko ibintu bimeze
answer: Slow down, communicate carefully and allow safe passage according to the situation
answer_rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko, kwitwararika no kureka ikinyabiziga kikanyura mu mutekano hakurikijwe uko ibintu bimeze
explanation: On a narrow road, avoid forcing passage. Use a safe passing place and follow any priority signs.
explanation_rw: Mu muhanda ufunganye, ntuhatire kunyura. Koresha ahantu hatekanye ho kunyuranira kandi ukurikize ibyapa bigena uwubanza.

question: You are driving uphill on a narrow road and meet a vehicle coming downhill. What should you do?
question_rw: Uri kuzamuka mu muhanda ufunganye uhura n'ikinyabiziga kirimo kumanuka. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Slow down and follow the applicable priority signs and safe-passing rules
Assume uphill vehicles always have priority
Force the downhill vehicle off the road
options_rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko ugakurikiza ibyapa bigena uwubanza n'amabwiriza yo kunyuranaho mu mutekano
Kwibwira ko ibinyabiziga bizamuka buri gihe ari byo bibanza
Guhatira ikinyabiziga kimanuka kuva mu muhanda
answer: Slow down and follow the applicable priority signs and safe-passing rules
answer_rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko ugakurikiza ibyapa bigena uwubanza n'amabwiriza yo kunyuranaho mu mutekano
explanation: Do not rely on assumptions about who has priority. Follow signs and make sure the passing manoeuvre is safe.
explanation_rw: Ntukishingikirize ku kwibwira ko ari wowe ufite uburenganzira bwo kubanza. Kurikiza ibyapa kandi wemeze ko kunyuranaho bitekanye.

question: A vehicle is waiting to turn into a side road and is blocking part of your lane. What should you do?
question_rw: Ikinyabiziga kirategereje gukata cyinjira mu muhanda wo ku ruhande kandi kibangamiye igice cy'umurongo wawe. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Slow down and pass only if it is safe and permitted
Force your way through the gap
options_rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko ukakinyuraho ari uko bitekanye kandi byemewe
answer: Slow down and pass only if it is safe and permitted
answer_rw: Kugabanya umuvuduko ukakinyuraho ari uko bitekanye kandi byemewe
explanation: Be patient and do not overtake if the manoeuvre would be dangerous or prohibited.
explanation_rw: Ihangane kandi nturenze ikinyabiziga niba kubikora byateza akaga cyangwa bibujijwe.

question: You want to change lanes near an intersection. What should you do first?
question_rw: Ushaka guhindura umurongo uri hafi y'isangano. Ni iki ugomba kubanza gukora?
options: Check mirrors and blind spots, signal and move only when safe
Assume other drivers will give way
options_rw: Kureba mu ndorerwamo no mu hantu utabonesha neza, gutanga ikimenyetso no kwimuka ari uko bitekanye
Kwibwira ko abandi bashoferi bazaguha inzira
answer: Check mirrors and blind spots, signal and move only when safe
answer_rw: Kureba mu ndorerwamo no mu hantu utabonesha neza, gutanga ikimenyetso no kwimuka ari uko bitekanye
explanation: A lane change must be planned and signalled. Never assume another driver will automatically give way.
explanation_rw: Guhindura umurongo bigomba kubanza gutegurwa no gutangirwa ikimenyetso. Ntukibwire ko undi mushoferi azahita aguha inzira.

question: You are approaching a junction and a vehicle behind you is driving very close. What should you do?
question_rw: Ugeze ku isangano kandi ikinyabiziga kiri inyuma yawe kikwegereye cyane. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Keep control, signal early and slow down gradually
Brake suddenly to teach the driver a lesson
options_rw: Gukomeza kugenzura imodoka, gutanga ikimenyetso hakiri kare no kugabanya umuvuduko buhoro
Gukandagira feri gitunguranye kugira ngo wigishe uwo mushoferi
answer: Keep control, signal early and slow down gradually
answer_rw: Gukomeza kugenzura imodoka, gutanga ikimenyetso hakiri kare no kugabanya umuvuduko buhoro
explanation: Do not react aggressively to a vehicle following too closely. Drive predictably and safely.
explanation_rw: Ntukagire imyitwarire mibi kubera ikinyabiziga kikwegereye inyuma. Twara mu buryo abandi bashobora kumva no guteganya, kandi utekanye.

question: A vehicle behind you wants to overtake near an intersection. What should you do?
question_rw: Ikinyabiziga kiri inyuma yawe kirashaka kukunyuraho hafi y'isangano. Ugomba gukora iki?
options: Maintain a steady course and do not increase speed
options_rw: Gukomeza mu murongo wawe kandi nt wongere umuvuduko
Guhatana na cyo ngo ubanze kugera ku isangano
answer: Maintain a steady course and do not increase speed
answer_rw: Gukomeza mu murongo wawe kandi nt wongere umuvuduko
explanation: Avoid competing with an overtaking vehicle. Keep a predictable course and never create danger.
explanation_rw: Ntuhatane n'ikinyabiziga kirimo kukunyuraho. Komeza mu murongo wawe kandi wirinde guteza akaga.

question: You are approaching a junction where road signs and a traffic officer appear to give different instructions. Which should you follow?
question_rw: Ugeze ku isangano aho ibyapa byo mu muhanda n'umupolisi bisa n'aho batanga amabwiriza atandukanye. Ugomba gukurikiza ayahe?
options: The instruction of the driver behind you
explanation: An authorised traffic officer's instructions take priority over road signs and other traffic controls.

explanation_rw: Insoro zitukura zitwara ogisijeni ziva mu bihaha ziyigeza mu bice bitandukanye by'umubiri.

question: Which African country was formerly known as Abyssinia?
question_rw: Ni ikihe gihugu cyo muri Afurika cyahoze cyitwa Abyssinia?
explanation: Abyssinia was the historical name commonly used for Ethiopia.
explanation_rw: Abyssinia ni izina ry'amateka ryakunze gukoreshwa ryerekeza kuri Etiyopiya.

question: How many bones are normally found in an adult human skeleton?
question_rw: Ubusanzwe umuntu mukuru agira amagufa angahe mu mubiri?
explanation: An average adult human skeleton has 206 bones.
explanation_rw: Ubusanzwe igikanka cy'umuntu mukuru kigira amagufa 206.

question: Which is the largest hot desert in the world?
question_rw: Ni ubuhe butayu bushyushye bunini kurusha ubundi ku Isi?
explanation: The Sahara is the world's largest hot desert.
explanation_rw: Sahara ni bwo butayu bushyushye bunini kurusha ubundi ku Isi.

question: What is the chemical formula for table salt?
question_rw: Ni iyihe nterano y'ibimenyetso by'ubutabire igaragaza umunyu usanzwe?
explanation: Table salt is mainly sodium chloride, with the chemical formula NaCl.
explanation_rw: Umunyu usanzwe ugizwe ahanini na sodiyumu kloridi, ifite ikimenyetso NaCl.

question: Which instrument is used to observe distant objects in space?
question_rw: Ni ikihe gikoresho gikoreshwa mu kwitegereza ibintu biri kure mu isanzure?
explanation: A telescope collects light and helps people observe distant objects in space.
explanation_rw: Telesikopi ikusanya urumuri igafasha abantu kwitegereza ibintu biri kure mu isanzure.

question: Which country is the origin of the Olympic Games in ancient history?
question_rw: Imikino Olempike ya kera yatangiriye mu kihe gihugu?
explanation: The ancient Olympic Games began in Olympia, Greece.
explanation_rw: Imikino Olempike ya kera yatangiriye i Olympia mu Bugereki.

question: What is the process by which plants release water vapour through their leaves?
question_rw: Ni ikihe gikorwa ibimera bisohoramo umwuka w'amazi binyuze mu mababi yabyo?
explanation: Transpiration is the release of water vapour from plant surfaces, especially leaves.
explanation_rw: Gusohora umwuka w'amazi ni igikorwa ibimera bisohoramo amazi yahindutse umwuka, cyane cyane binyuze mu mababi.

question: Which country has the largest population in Africa?
question_rw: Ni ikihe gihugu gifite abaturage benshi kurusha ibindi muri Afurika?
explanation: Nigeria is the most populous country in Africa.
explanation_rw: Nijeriya ni cyo gihugu gifite abaturage benshi kurusha ibindi muri Afurika.

question: Which part of the brain is mainly responsible for balance and coordination?
question_rw: Ni ikihe gice cy'ubwonko gifite uruhare runini mu kuringaniza umubiri no guhuza imikorere y'ingingo?
explanation: The cerebellum helps control balance, posture and coordinated movement.
explanation_rw: Ubwonko buto bufasha kuringaniza umubiri, guhagarara neza no guhuza imigendere y'ingingo.

question: What is the capital city of Canada?
question_rw: Umurwa mukuru wa Kanada ni uwuhe?
explanation: Ottawa is the capital city of Canada.
explanation_rw: Ottawa ni wo murwa mukuru wa Kanada.

question: Which element has the chemical symbol Fe?
question_rw: Ni ikihe kinyabutabire kigaragazwa n'ikimenyetso Fe?
explanation: Fe is the chemical symbol for iron.
explanation_rw: Fe ni ikimenyetso cy'ubutabire kigaragaza icyuma.

question: Which natural satellite orbits the Earth?
question_rw: Ni uwuhe mubumbe muto kamere uzenguruka Isi?
explanation: The Moon is Earth's natural satellite.
explanation_rw: Ukwezi ni umubumbe muto kamere uzenguruka Isi.

question: Which language has the largest number of native speakers worldwide?
question_rw: Ni uruhe rurimi rufite abantu benshi baruvuga nk'ururimi kavukire ku Isi?
explanation: Mandarin Chinese has the largest number of native speakers worldwide.
explanation_rw: Igishinwa cya Mandarin ni rwo rurimi rufite abantu benshi baruvuga nk'ururimi kavukire ku Isi.

question: What is the main source of energy for Earth's climate system?
question_rw: Ni ikihe soko nyamukuru y'ingufu zituma imiterere y'ikirere cyo ku Isi ibaho?
explanation: Solar energy drives most weather and climate processes on Earth.
explanation_rw: Ingufu z'izuba ni zo zituma ibikorwa byinshi by'ikirere n'imihindagurikire yacyo bibaho ku Isi.

question: Which part of a computer temporarily stores data currently being used?
question_rw: Ni ikihe gice cya mudasobwa kibika by'agateganyo amakuru arimo gukoreshwa?
explanation: RAM temporarily stores data and instructions that the computer is actively using.
explanation_rw: RAM ibika by'agateganyo amakuru n'amabwiriza mudasobwa irimo gukoresha.

question: Which layer of the Earth is made mostly of solid iron and nickel?
question_rw: Ni ikihe gice cy'imbere mu Isi kigizwe ahanini n'icyuma na nikel biri mu buryo bukomeye?
explanation: Earth's inner core is mainly solid iron and nickel.
explanation_rw: Igice cy'imbere cyo hagati mu Isi kigizwe ahanini n'icyuma na nikel biri mu buryo bukomeye.

question: Which country is known as the Land of the Rising Sun?
question_rw: Ni ikihe gihugu kizwi ku izina ry'Igihugu cy'Izuba Rirasira?
explanation: Japan is commonly known as the Land of the Rising Sun.
explanation_rw: Ubuyapani buzwi cyane ku izina ry'Igihugu cy'Izuba Rirasira.

question: What is the name of the force that opposes motion between two surfaces in contact?
question_rw: Imbaraga zirwanya ukunyerera cyangwa kugenda kw'ibintu bibiri bikoranaho zitwa iki?
explanation: Friction is a force that resists relative motion between surfaces in contact.
explanation_rw: Ubushyamirane ni imbaraga zirwanya kugenda cyangwa kunyerera kw'ibintu bikoranaho.

question: Which African lake is the largest by surface area?
question_rw: Ni iyihe nyanja yo muri Afurika nini kurusha izindi iyo harebwe ubuso bwayo?
explanation: Lake Victoria is Africa's largest lake by surface area.
explanation_rw: Ikiyaga cya Victoria ni cyo kinini muri Afurika iyo harebwe ubuso bwacyo.

question: Which scientist is associated with the laws of motion and universal gravitation?
question_rw: Ni uwuhe muhanga uzwiho gushyiraho amategeko y'uburyo ibintu bigenda n'ay'imbaraga rukuruzi rusange?
explanation: Isaac Newton formulated the three laws of motion and the law of universal gravitation.
explanation_rw: Isaac Newton yashyizeho amategeko atatu agenga uko ibintu bigenda n'itegeko ry'imbaraga rukuruzi rusange.

question: What is the study of earthquakes called?
question_rw: Ubumenyi bwiga imitingito y'Isi bwitwa iki?
explanation: Seismology is the scientific study of earthquakes and seismic waves.
explanation_rw: Ubumenyi bw'imitingito y'Isi bwiga imitingito n'imivumba y'ingufu ikwirakwira mu Isi.

question: Which organ filters waste products from the blood to produce urine?
question_rw: Ni uruhe rugingo ruyungurura imyanda iva mu maraso kugira ngo hakorwe inkari?
explanation: The kidneys filter blood and remove waste products by producing urine.
explanation_rw: Impyiko ziyungurura amaraso zigakuramo imyanda binyuze mu gukora inkari.

question: Which international organization has its headquarters in New York City?
question_rw: Ni uwuhe muryango mpuzamahanga ufite icyicaro gikuru mu mujyi wa New York?
explanation: The United Nations headquarters is located in New York City, United States.
explanation_rw: Icyicaro gikuru cy'Umuryango w'Abibumbye giherereye mu mujyi wa New York muri Leta Zunze Ubumwe za Amerika.

question: Which metal is liquid at ordinary room temperature?
question_rw: Ni ikihe cyuma kiba mu buryo bw'amazi ku bushyuhe busanzwe bwo mu cyumba?
explanation: Mercury is a metal that remains liquid at ordinary room temperature.
explanation_rw: Merikire ni icyuma kiba mu buryo bw'amazi ku bushyuhe busanzwe bwo mu cyumba.

question: What is the approximate speed of light in a vacuum?
question_rw: Umuvuduko w'urumuri mu cyuho ungana hafi iki?
explanation: Light travels at approximately 300,000 kilometres per second in a vacuum.
explanation_rw: Urumuri rugenda ku muvuduko ungana hafi na kilometero 300,000 ku isegonda mu cyuho.

question: Which branch of biology studies insects?
question_rw: Ni ikihe gice cy'ubumenyi bw'ibinyabuzima cyiga udukoko?
explanation: Entomology is the branch of biology that studies insects.
explanation_rw: Ubumenyi bw'udukoko ni ishami ry'ubumenyi bw'ibinyabuzima ryiga udukoko.

question: What is the main function of the ozone layer?
question_rw: Ni uwuhe murimo w'ingenzi w'urwego rwa ozone rukikije Isi?
explanation: The ozone layer absorbs much of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.
explanation_rw: Urwego rwa ozone rukumira igice kinini cy'imirasire ya ultraviolet yangiza ituruka ku zuba.

question: Which economic term describes a general rise in prices over time?
question_rw: Ni irihe jambo mu bukungu risobanura izamuka rusange ry'ibiciro uko igihe kigenda gihita?
explanation: Inflation is a sustained increase in the general price level of goods and services.
explanation_rw: Izamuka ry'ibiciro ni ukwiyongera gukomeza k'urwego rusange rw'ibiciro by'ibicuruzwa na serivisi.

question: What is the main purpose of Rwanda's Law No. 014/2026 governing road traffic?
question_rw: Intego nyamukuru y'Itegeko N° 014/2026 rigenga ikoreshwa ry'umuhanda mu Rwanda ni iyihe?
options: To increase the number of vehicles
explanation: Article 1 establishes that the law governs road traffic with the aim of preventing road traffic accidents.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 1 igaragaza ko iri tegeko rigenga ikoreshwa ry'umuhanda hagamijwe gukumira impanuka zo mu muhanda.

question: According to Article 3 of Law No. 014/2026, which activity falls within the scope of the law?
question_rw: Dukurikije Ingingo ya 3 y'Itegeko N° 014/2026, ni iki kiri mu byo iri tegeko rigenga?
explanation: Article 3 applies the law to road traffic and excludes railways, cableways and other special routes.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 3 igaragaza ko iri tegeko rireba ikoreshwa ry'umuhanda, ariko ntirireba inzira za gari ya moshi, iz'insinga n'izindi nzira zihariye.

question: On which side of the road must vehicles travel in Rwanda?
question_rw: Mu Rwanda, ibinyabiziga bigomba kugendera ku ruhande uruhe rw'umuhanda?
options_rw: Ku ruhande urwo ari rwo rwose
explanation: Article 4 of Law No. 014/2026 establishes the right-hand side as the driving side in Rwanda.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 4 y'Itegeko N° 014/2026 iteganya ko ibinyabiziga bigendera ku ruhande rw'iburyo rw'umuhanda.

question: Which group of road users is expressly covered by the road traffic rules described in Article 5?
question_rw: Ni ikihe cyiciro cy'abakoresha umuhanda kivugwa mu byubahirizwa mu ikoreshwa ry'umuhanda biteganywa n'Ingingo ya 5?
options_rw: Abagenzi ba gari ya moshi gusa
Abantu bari mu nyubako zabo bwite
explanation: Article 5 includes rules governing how pedestrians, vehicles and certain animals move on roads.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 5 ikubiyemo uburyo abanyamaguru, ibinyabiziga n'inyamaswa zimwe na zimwe bigenda mu muhanda.

question: Which subject is included among the road traffic rules under Article 5?
question_rw: Ni ikihe kibazo kiri mu byubahirizwa mu ikoreshwa ry'umuhanda bivugwa mu Ngigo ya 5?
options: Road users' obligations when an accident occurs
options_rw: Inshingano z'abakoresha umuhanda igihe habaye impanuka
Amategeko yo kugura ibikoresho byo mu rugo
answer: Road users' obligations when an accident occurs
answer_rw: Inshingano z'abakoresha umuhanda igihe habaye impanuka
explanation: Article 5 expressly includes the obligations of road users in the event of a road traffic accident.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 5 ivuga ko amategeko agenga umuhanda akubiyemo inshingano z'ukoresha umuhanda igihe habaye impanuka.

question: Who has the authority to control road traffic under Article 6?
question_rw: Dukurikije Ingingo ya 6, ni nde ufite ububasha bwo kugenzura ikoreshwa ry'umuhanda?
options: An investigator or an authorised officer
options_rw: Nyiri iduka uwo ari we wese
Umukanishi wigenga uwo ari we wese
answer: An investigator or an authorised officer
explanation: Article 6 gives road traffic control powers to an investigator or an authorised officer.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 6 iha umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha inshingano zo kugenzura ikoreshwa ry'umuhanda.

question: What is the purpose of instructions issued by an investigator or authorised officer under Article 6?
question_rw: Amabwiriza atangwa n'umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha agamije iki hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 6?
explanation: Article 6 states that instructions from authorised personnel are intended to ensure road safety.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 6 ivuga ko amabwiriza atangwa n'ababifitiye ububasha agamije kubungabunga umutekano wo mu muhanda.

question: What happens when an authorised officer gives an instruction that conflicts with a road traffic sign?
question_rw: Bigenda bite iyo umukozi ubifitiye ububasha atanze amabwiriza anyuranyije n'ikimenyetso cy'umuhanda?
options: The officer's instruction takes precedence in that situation
The driver may ignore both instructions
The road sign always takes precedence
The driver chooses whichever instruction is easier
options_rw: Amabwiriza y'uwo mukozi ni yo akurikizwa muri icyo gihe
Ikimenyetso cy'umuhanda ni cyo gihora kigenderwaho
answer: The officer's instruction takes precedence in that situation
answer_rw: Amabwiriza y'uwo mukozi ni yo akurikizwa muri icyo gihe
explanation: Article 6(3) provides that instructions from an investigator or authorised officer supersede road traffic signs or signals in that situation.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 6(3) iteganya ko amabwiriza y'umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha asimbura ibimenyetso bigenga ikoreshwa ry'umuhanda muri icyo gihe.

question: Which authority may require a driver to undergo an alcohol or drug test when necessary for road safety?
question_rw: Ni uruhe rwego rushobora gutegeka umushoferi gupimwa arukoro cyangwa ibiyobyabwenge igihe bibaye ngombwa mu rwego rwo kubungabunga umutekano wo mu muhanda?
options: An investigator or an authorised officer
options_rw: Umugenzi mugenzi we uwo ari we wese
answer: An investigator or an authorised officer
explanation: Article 10 authorises an investigator or authorised officer to conduct or order appropriate tests when necessary for road safety.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 10 iha umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha ububasha bwo gupima cyangwa gutegeka gupima igihe bibaye ngombwa mu kubungabunga umutekano wo mu muhanda.

question: A driver disagrees with the result of an alcohol or drug test. What may the driver request under Article 10?
question_rw: Umushoferi ntiyemeye ibyavuye mu isuzuma rya arukoro cyangwa ibiyobyabwenge. Ni iki ashobora gusaba hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 10?
options: A new driving licence without examination
explanation: Article 10(2) allows a driver who disagrees with the test results to request testing by an accredited laboratory.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 10(2) yemerera umushoferi utanyuzwe n'ibyavuye mu isuzuma gusaba ko apimwa na laboratwari yemerewe kubikora.

question: What is the maximum permissible blood alcohol concentration stated in Article 9 of Law No. 014/2026?
question_rw: Igipimo ntarengwa cya arukoro mu maraso cyavuzwe mu Ngigo ya 9 y'Itegeko N° 014/2026 ni ikihe?
explanation: Article 9(1) states a maximum permissible blood alcohol concentration of 0.80 grams per litre. Article 9(2) allows a Ministerial Order to lower this limit.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 9(1) igena igipimo ntarengwa cya garama 0.80 muri litiro imwe y'amaraso. Ingingo ya 9(2) yemera ko iteka rya Minisitiri rishobora kugabanya icyo gipimo.

question: Who must hold a driving licence authorising the vehicle being driven?
question_rw: Ni nde ugomba kugira uruhushya rumwemerera gutwara ikinyabiziga arimo gutwara?
options: A person driving a motor vehicle on a road
Every vehicle owner who never drives
options_rw: Umuntu utwaye ikinyabiziga gifite moteri mu muhanda
answer: A person driving a motor vehicle on a road
answer_rw: Umuntu utwaye ikinyabiziga gifite moteri mu muhanda
explanation: Article 23(1) requires a motor vehicle driver to hold a driving licence authorising the driving of that vehicle.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 23(1) isaba utwaye ikinyabiziga gifite moteri kugira uruhushya rumwemerera gutwara icyo kinyabiziga.

question: Which institution has exclusive competence to administer motor vehicle driving tests and issue driving licences under Article 23?
question_rw: Ni uruhe rwego rufite ububasha bwihariye bwo gukora ibizamini byo gutwara ibinyabiziga no gutanga impushya zo kubitwara hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 23?
options: The organ in charge of road safety
options_rw: Urwego rushinzwe kurinda umutekano wo mu muhanda
Umunyeshuri uwo ari we wese wiga gutwara
answer: The organ in charge of road safety
answer_rw: Urwego rushinzwe kurinda umutekano wo mu muhanda
explanation: Article 23(2) gives the organ in charge of road safety exclusive competence to administer driving tests and issue the corresponding licences.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 23(2) iha urwego rushinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda ububasha bwihariye bwo gukora ibizamini no gutanga impushya zijyanye na byo.

question: Who is authorised to provide driving instruction under Article 24?
question_rw: Ni nde wemerewe gutanga inyigisho zo gutwara ibinyabiziga hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 24?
options: A person who owns an authorised driving school
Any person who owns a private car
options_rw: Umuntu ufite ishuri ryigisha gutwara ibinyabiziga kandi yabiherewe uburenganzira
Umugenzi wese ufite uburambe mu muhanda
answer: A person who owns an authorised driving school
answer_rw: Umuntu ufite ishuri ryigisha gutwara ibinyabiziga kandi yabiherewe uburenganzira
explanation: Article 24(1) states that driving instruction is provided by a person who owns a driving school and has obtained authorisation.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 24(1) ivuga ko inyigisho zo gutwara ibinyabiziga zitangwa n'umuntu ufite ishuri ribyigisha kandi yarahawe uburenganzira bwo kurikoresha.

question: Which organ supervises and monitors driving schools in Rwanda?
question_rw: Ni uruhe rwego rugenzura kandi rugakurikirana amashuri yigisha gutwara ibinyabiziga mu Rwanda?
options: The organ in charge of road safety
options_rw: Urwego rushinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda
answer: The organ in charge of road safety
answer_rw: Urwego rushinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda
explanation: Article 24(2) gives the organ in charge of road safety exclusive competence to supervise and monitor driving schools.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 24(2) iha urwego rushinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda ububasha bwihariye bwo kugenzura no gukurikirana amashuri yigisha gutwara.

question: Which system is established under Article 25 to monitor the behaviour of motor vehicle drivers?
question_rw: Ni ubuhe buryo bwashyizweho n'Ingingo ya 25 bwo gukurikirana imyitwarire y'abatwara ibinyabiziga bifite moteri?
options: A merit and demerit point system
options_rw: Uburyo bw'amanota y'imyitwarire meza n'imyitwarire mibi
Uburyo bwo gutondeka ibinyabiziga hakurikijwe amabara
Uburyo bwo gutora abashoferi hakoreshejwe abagenzi
answer: A merit and demerit point system
answer_rw: Uburyo bw'amanota y'imyitwarire meza n'imyitwarire mibi
explanation: Article 25 establishes a merit and demerit point system for monitoring the behaviour of motor vehicle drivers.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 25 ishyiraho uburyo bw'amanota y'imyitwarire myiza n'imyitwarire mibi hagamijwe gukurikirana imyitwarire y'abatwara ibinyabiziga bifite moteri.

question: Under Article 27, what may happen to a driving licence because of the driver's road traffic-related behaviour?
question_rw: Hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 27, ni iki gishobora kuba ku ruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga bitewe n'imyitwarire y'umushoferi mu muhanda?
options: It is transferred to another driver
It is converted into a vehicle registration certificate
explanation: Article 27 allows the organ in charge of road safety to suspend a driving licence temporarily because of the driver's road traffic-related behaviour.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 27 yemerera urwego rushinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda guhagarika by'agateganyo uruhushya bitewe n'imyitwarire y'umushoferi mu muhanda.

question: Who orders the revocation of a driving licence under Article 28?
question_rw: Ni nde ufata icyemezo cyo gutesha agaciro uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 28?
explanation: Article 28(1) states that revocation of a driving licence is ordered by a competent court upon application by the organ in charge of road safety.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 28(1) ivuga ko uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga ruteshwa agaciro n'urukiko rubifitiye ububasha, rubisabwe n'urwego rushinzwe umutekano wo mu muhanda.

question: How long must a person wait before taking another driving test after a court revokes their driving licence under Article 28?
question_rw: Umuntu wambuwe uruhushya rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga n'urukiko agomba gutegereza igihe kingana iki mbere yo kongera gukora ikizamini?
explanation: Article 28(2) prevents a person whose licence has been revoked from taking another driving test before 12 months have expired from the court's decision.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 28(2) iteganya ko umuntu wambuwe uruhushya n'urukiko atemerewe kongera gukora ikizamini mbere y'uko amezi 12 ashira uhereye ku cyemezo cy'urukiko.

question: Which identification requirement applies to a motor vehicle authorised for road use in Rwanda under Article 29?
question_rw: Ni ikihe gisabwa ku biranga ikinyabiziga cyemerewe kugendera mu muhanda mu Rwanda hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 29?
options: It must be registered and bear valid identification marks
It must have a personalised paint colour
It must carry no identification marks
It must be registered only in a neighbouring country
options_rw: Kigomba kuba cyanditswe kandi gifite ibirango bikiranga byemewe
Kigomba kuba gifite ibara ryihariye ry'umuntu
Kigomba kuba cyanditswe mu gihugu gituranye gusa
answer: It must be registered and bear valid identification marks
answer_rw: Kigomba kuba cyanditswe kandi gifite ibirango bikiranga byemewe
explanation: Article 29(1) recognises vehicles registered in Rwanda with identification marks and foreign-registered vehicles bearing marks issued by their country of registration in accordance with applicable law.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 29(1) yemera ibinyabiziga byanditswe mu Rwanda bifite ibirango bikiranga, n'ibyo mu mahanga bifite ibirango byatanzwe n'igihugu byanditswemo hakurikijwe amategeko.

question: What steering-wheel position is generally required for a car to be registered in Rwanda under Article 29?
question_rw: Ni ku ruhe ruhande icyuma kiyobora imodoka kigomba kuba kiriho kugira ngo imodoka isanzwe yandikishwe mu Rwanda hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 29?
options: On the right-hand side in every case
In the centre of the dashboard
At the rear of the vehicle
options_rw: Ku ruhande rw'iburyo mu bihe byose
explanation: Article 29(2) generally provides for a left-hand-drive car, subject to the exceptions listed in that Article.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 29(2) iteganya ko imodoka yandikwa mu Rwanda iba ifite icyuma kiyobora ku ruhande rw'ibumoso, uretse ibinyabiziga byavuzwe nk'ibidasanzwe muri iyo ngingo.

question: For how long may a foreign-registered right-hand-drive car use Rwandan roads under Article 29(3), subject to the law?
question_rw: Imodoka yanditswe mu kindi gihugu ifite icyuma kiyobora iburyo ishobora kumara igihe kingana iki ikoresha imihanda y'u Rwanda hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 29(3), hubahirijwe amategeko?
options: Up to three months from the date of entry into Rwanda
For an unlimited period without conditions
options_rw: Amezi atatu uhereye igihe yinjiye mu Rwanda
answer: Up to three months from the date of entry into Rwanda
answer_rw: Amezi atatu uhereye igihe yinjiye mu Rwanda
explanation: Article 29(3) allows such a foreign-registered vehicle to use Rwandan roads for a period not exceeding three months from entry. The Minister may extend the period following a written request.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 29(3) yemera ko ikinyabiziga nk'icyo cyanditswe mu kindi gihugu gikoresha imihanda y'u Rwanda mu gihe kitarenze amezi atatu uhereye igihe cyinjiye mu Rwanda. Minisitiri ashobora kongera icyo gihe abisabwe mu nyandiko.

question: What must happen before a motor vehicle is operated on a road under Article 31?
question_rw: Ni iki kigomba kubanza gukorwa mbere y'uko ikinyabiziga gifite moteri gikoreshwa mu muhanda hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 31?
options: It must undergo an authorised technical inspection and receive a certificate
It must be sold to another person
It must travel outside Rwanda first
options_rw: Kigomba gukorerwa isuzuma rya tekiniki n'ikigo cyemewe kandi kigahabwa icyemezo
Kigomba kubanza kujya hanze y'u Rwanda
answer: It must undergo an authorised technical inspection and receive a certificate
answer_rw: Kigomba gukorerwa isuzuma rya tekiniki n'ikigo cyemewe kandi kigahabwa icyemezo
explanation: Article 31(1) requires a motor vehicle to undergo technical inspection at an authorised centre and receive a technical inspection certificate.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 31(1) isaba ko ikinyabiziga gikorerwa isuzuma rya tekiniki n'ikigo cyabyemerewe kandi kigahabwa icyemezo cy'iryo suzuma.

question: What happens when a technical inspection finds irreparable technical defects in a motor vehicle?
question_rw: Bigenda bite iyo isuzuma rya tekiniki rigaragaje ko ikinyabiziga gifite inenge za tekiniki zidashobora gukosorwa?
options: It loses the right to operate on the road
It automatically receives a new inspection certificate
It is allowed to operate without restrictions
Its registration is transferred to another vehicle
options_rw: Kinyagwa uburenganzira bwo kugendera mu muhanda
Icyangombwa cyacyo gihita gihabwa ikindi kinyabiziga
answer: It loses the right to operate on the road
answer_rw: Kinyagwa uburenganzira bwo kugendera mu muhanda
explanation: Article 31(3) provides that a vehicle with irreparable technical defects found during inspection forfeits the right to operate on the road.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 31(3) iteganya ko ikinyabiziga gisanzwe gifite inenge za tekiniki zidashobora gukemurwa nyuma y'isuzuma kinyagwa uburenganzira bwo kugendera mu muhanda.

question: What type of fault does a road user commit by failing to comply with road traffic regulations under Article 33?
question_rw: Umukoresha umuhanda utubahirije amategeko y'ikoreshwa ryawo aba akoze ikosa ryo mu rwego uruhe hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 33?
explanation: Article 33(1) classifies failure by a road user to comply with road traffic regulations as an administrative fault.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 33(1) isobanura ko umukoresha umuhanda utubahirije amategeko y'ikoreshwa ryawo aba akoze ikosa ryo mu rwego rw'ubutegetsi.

question: Who determines the list of administrative road traffic faults, their fines and applicable demerit points?
question_rw: Ni nde ugena urutonde rw'amakosa yo mu rwego rw'ubutegetsi yo mu muhanda, amande yayo n'amanota y'imyitwarire mibi ajyanye na yo?
options_rw: Abanyeshuri biga gutwara ku giti cyabo
explanation: Article 33(2) assigns the determination of administrative faults, corresponding fines and demerit points to a Ministerial Order.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 33(2) iteganya ko urutonde rw'amakosa, amande ajyanye na yo n'amanota akurwa ku wakoze ikosa bigenwa n'iteka rya Minisitiri.

question: Within how many days must an administrative road traffic fine normally be paid after receiving the official notification?
question_rw: Ihazabu yo mu rwego rw'ubutegetsi ijyanye n'ikosa ryo mu muhanda igomba kwishyurwa mu gihe cy'iminsi ingahe nyuma yo kwakira ubutumwa buyimenyesha?
explanation: Article 34(1) gives a person sanctioned with an administrative fine 30 days from receipt of the official notification to pay.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 34(1) iha uhanishijwe ihazabu yo mu rwego rw'ubutegetsi iminsi 30 yo kuyishyura, uhereye igihe yakiriye ubutumwa bumumenyesha ikosa.

question: What surcharge is provided for when an administrative road traffic fine is not paid within the prescribed period?
question_rw: Ni ikihe gipimo cy'inyongera giteganywa iyo ihazabu yo mu rwego rw'ubutegetsi itishyuwe mu gihe cyagenwe?
explanation: Article 34(2) provides for a surcharge of 30% of the initial administrative fine when the prescribed payment period expires without payment.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 34(2) iteganya ko iyo igihe cyo kwishyura kirangiye umuntu atarishyura, hongerwaho 30% by'ihazabu ya mbere.

question: What information must an electronic document issued for a road safety-related fault contain?
question_rw: Inyandiko koranabuhanga ihabwa umushoferi wakoze ikosa rihungabanya umutekano wo mu muhanda igomba kugaragaza ayahe makuru?
options: The fault committed and the sanction imposed
answer: The fault committed and the sanction imposed
explanation: Article 35(2) requires an electronic document indicating the road safety fault committed and the sanction imposed.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 35(2) isaba ko umushoferi ahabwa inyandiko koranabuhanga igaragaza ikosa yakoze n'igihano yahawe.

question: Who may request reconsideration of a road traffic fault and its sanction under Article 36?
question_rw: Ni nde ushobora gusaba ko hasubirwamo icyemezo cy'ikosa ryo mu muhanda n'igihano cyaryo hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 36?
options: The driver, vehicle owner or legally authorised representative
Only a passenger who was not involved
options_rw: Umushoferi, nyiri ikinyabiziga cyangwa umuhagarariye wemewe n'amategeko
answer: The driver, vehicle owner or legally authorised representative
answer_rw: Umushoferi, nyiri ikinyabiziga cyangwa umuhagarariye wemewe n'amategeko
explanation: Article 36(1) allows a driver, vehicle owner or legally authorised representative to request reconsideration of the fault.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 36(1) yemera ko umushoferi, nyiri ikinyabiziga cyangwa umuhagarariye wemewe n'amategeko asaba ko icyemezo cy'ikosa gisubirwamo.

question: Within how many working days must a person normally request reconsideration of a notified road traffic fault under Article 36?
question_rw: Umuntu agomba gusaba ko hasubirwamo icyemezo cy'ikosa ryo mu muhanda mu gihe cy'iminsi ingahe y'akazi nyuma yo kumenyeshwa iryo kosa?
explanation: Article 36(1) provides a period of three working days from notification of the fault to request reconsideration.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 36(1) iteganya ko usaba ko icyemezo gisubirwamo abikora mu minsi itatu y'akazi uhereye igihe yamenyesherejwe ikosa.

question: Within how many working days should a person who requested reconsideration receive a written response under Article 36?
question_rw: Umuntu wasabye ko icyemezo cy'ikosa ryo mu muhanda gisubirwamo agomba gusubizwa mu nyandiko mu minsi ingahe y'akazi?
explanation: Article 36(2) provides for a written response within three working days after the request for reconsideration is filed.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 36(2) iteganya ko uwatanze ubusabe bwo gusubirishamo icyemezo ahabwa igisubizo mu nyandiko mu minsi itatu y'akazi uhereye igihe yatanze ubusabe.

question: What is a driver committing by driving a motor vehicle without the required driving licence?
question_rw: Umuntu utwaye ikinyabiziga gifite moteri nta ruhushya rumwemerera kugenda aba akoze iki?
options_rw: Igikorwa gisanzwe cyemewe mu rwego rw'ubutegetsi
Imyitozo isanzwe yo mu ishuri ryo gutwara
explanation: Article 40(1) states that a motor vehicle driver who drives without a driving licence commits an offence.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 40(1) ivuga ko umuntu utwara ikinyabiziga gifite moteri atagira uruhushya rwo kugitwara aba akoze icyaha.

question: What does Article 37 address in relation to driving?
question_rw: Ingingo ya 37 y'Itegeko N° 014/2026 ivuga iki ku bijyanye no gutwara ikinyabiziga?
options: Driving with a blood alcohol concentration exceeding the permitted limit
Driving with an expired vehicle colour certificate
options_rw: Gutwara ikinyabiziga warengeje igipimo ntarengwa cya arukoro mu maraso
Gutwara ikinyabiziga gifite icyemezo cy'ibara cyarengeje igihe
answer: Driving with a blood alcohol concentration exceeding the permitted limit
answer_rw: Gutwara ikinyabiziga warengeje igipimo ntarengwa cya arukoro mu maraso
explanation: Article 37 establishes an offence and penalties for driving with a blood alcohol concentration exceeding the permissible level.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 37 iteganya ko gutwara ikinyabiziga warengeje igipimo ntarengwa cya arukoro mu maraso ari icyaha kandi igateganya ibihano byacyo.

question: What does Article 38 address?
question_rw: Ingingo ya 38 y'Itegeko N° 014/2026 ivuga iki?
options: Refusal to submit to blood alcohol concentration testing
Refusal to buy vehicle insurance from a specific company
options_rw: Kwanga gupimwa igipimo cya arukoro mu maraso
Kwanga kugura ubwishingizi mu kigo runaka
answer: Refusal to submit to blood alcohol concentration testing
answer_rw: Kwanga gupimwa igipimo cya arukoro mu maraso
explanation: Article 38 specifically addresses refusal to submit to blood alcohol concentration testing.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 38 ivuga ku cyaha cyo kwanga gupimwa igipimo cya arukoro mu maraso.

question: What offence is covered by Article 39?
question_rw: Ni ikihe cyaha kivugwa mu Ngigo ya 39?
options: Refusing to stop when ordered by an investigator or authorised officer
Stopping at an authorised parking place
options_rw: Kwanga guhagarara igihe ubitegetswe n'umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha
answer: Refusing to stop when ordered by an investigator or authorised officer
answer_rw: Kwanga guhagarara igihe ubitegetswe n'umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha
explanation: Article 39 addresses the offence of refusing to stop when ordered by an investigator or authorised officer.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 39 ivuga ku cyaha cyo kwanga guhagarara igihe ubitegetswe n'umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha.

question: Which vehicles are included in the special category mentioned in Article 37(1)(a) for alcohol-related offences?
question_rw: Ni ibihe binyabiziga biri mu cyiciro cyihariye kivugwa mu Ngigo ya 37(1)(a) ku byaha bifitanye isano no kurenza igipimo cya arukoro?
options: Public transport, school transport and staff transport vehicles
options_rw: Ibinyabiziga bitwara abantu mu buryo bwa rusange, abanyeshuri n'abakozi
answer: Public transport, school transport and staff transport vehicles
answer_rw: Ibinyabiziga bitwara abantu mu buryo bwa rusange, abanyeshuri n'abakozi
explanation: Article 37(1)(a) lists public transport, school transport, staff transport, tourist transport and certain goods vehicles among the specified categories.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 37(1)(a) ivuga ibinyabiziga bitwara abantu mu buryo bwa rusange, abanyeshuri, abakozi, ba mukerarugendo n'ibinyabiziga bimwe na bimwe bitwara imizigo mu byiciro byihariye.

question: What is the main purpose of technical inspection of a motor vehicle?
question_rw: Intego nyamukuru y'isuzuma rya tekiniki ry'ikinyabiziga ni iyihe?
options: To establish whether the vehicle meets technical requirements for road use
To determine the driver's favourite route
To choose the vehicle's paint colour
To decide the vehicle's selling price
options_rw: Kureba niba ikinyabiziga cyujuje ibisabwa bya tekiniki kugira ngo gikoreshe umuhanda
answer: To establish whether the vehicle meets technical requirements for road use
answer_rw: Kureba niba ikinyabiziga cyujuje ibisabwa bya tekiniki kugira ngo gikoreshe umuhanda
explanation: Article 31 requires authorised technical inspection and provides for withdrawal of road-use rights where irreparable defects are found.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 31 isaba isuzuma rya tekiniki rikozwe n'ikigo cyemewe kandi iteganya kwamburwa uburenganzira bwo kugendera mu muhanda igihe habonetse inenge zidashobora gukosorwa.

question: Which subjects are included in the detailed road traffic rules referred to in Article 5?
question_rw: Ni ibihe bintu biri mu byiciro by'amategeko arambuye agenga ikoreshwa ry'umuhanda bivugwa mu Ngigo ya 5?
options: Road signs and vehicle identification marks
options_rw: Ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda n'ibiranga ibinyabiziga
Uburyo bwo gufungura konti muri banki
answer: Road signs and vehicle identification marks
answer_rw: Ibimenyetso byo mu muhanda n'ibiranga ibinyabiziga
explanation: Article 5 includes road traffic signs and vehicle identification marks among the matters governed by detailed road traffic rules.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 5 ikubiyemo ibimenyetso bigenga ikoreshwa ry'umuhanda n'ibiranga ibinyabiziga mu byubahirizwa bigomba gusobanurwa birambuye.

question: Which authority may issue instructions to road users for the purpose of maintaining road safety?
question_rw: Ni nde ushobora guha abakoresha umuhanda amabwiriza agamije kubungabunga umutekano wo mu muhanda?
options: Any person waiting at a bus stop
options_rw: Umuntu uwo ari we wese utegereje imodoka
Nyiri ubucuruzi bwigenga uwo ari we wese
explanation: Article 6(2) provides that an investigator or authorised officer may issue instructions intended to ensure road safety.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 6(2) iteganya ko umugenzacyaha cyangwa umukozi ubifitiye ububasha ashobora gutanga amabwiriza agamije kubungabunga umutekano wo mu muhanda.

question: What must a foreign-registered vehicle have to qualify for road use in Rwanda under Article 29?
question_rw: Ikinyabiziga cyanditswe mu kindi gihugu kigomba kuba gifite iki kugira ngo cyemererwe gukoresha umuhanda mu Rwanda hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 29?
options: Identification marks issued by its country of registration in accordance with the law
A handwritten number chosen by its driver
Only a photograph of the vehicle
options_rw: Ibirango byatanzwe n'igihugu cyanditswemo hakurikijwe amategeko
answer: Identification marks issued by its country of registration in accordance with the law
answer_rw: Ibirango byatanzwe n'igihugu cyanditswemo hakurikijwe amategeko
explanation: Article 29(1) recognises foreign-registered motor vehicles bearing identification marks issued by their country of registration in accordance with relevant legislation.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 29(1) yemera ibinyabiziga byanditswe mu mahanga bifite ibirango byatanzwe n'igihugu byanditswemo hakurikijwe amategeko abigenga.

question: On what date did Law No. 014/2026 governing road traffic enter into force?
question_rw: Itegeko N° 014/2026 rigenga ikoreshwa ry'umuhanda ryatangiye gukurikizwa ku yihe tariki?
explanation: Article 45 provides for the law to enter into force on the date of its publication in the Official Gazette, which was 10 March 2026.
explanation_rw: Ingingo ya 45 iteganya ko iri tegeko ritangira gukurikizwa ku munsi ritangarijweho mu Igazeti ya Leta, ari wo wa 10 Werurwe 2026.
